input.relationship: src/lru.ts#imageAllocation call src/weights.ts#allocationWeight (forward); src/weights.ts#allocationWeight value-reference src/weights.ts#entryWeight (forward)

evidence.reason: New function divides weights.allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'image') by weights.byteUnit, directly consuming the refactored weight path.
Refactored to return weightDetails(bytes, overhead, category).bytes, removing the explicit RangeError and header/overhead arithmetic that callers may have relied on.
Caller returns imageAllocation(bytes), so any change in allocationWeight/entryWeight output propagates to admittedBytes.
Caller interpolates imageAllocation(bytes) into a label, so changed numeric output would alter user-visible strings.
Comment states cache capacity includes index overhead in bytes; the new delegation must preserve that documented behavior.

result.userExplanation: 右侧将 entryWeight 改为委托 weightDetails，但未提供 weightDetails 实现且无测试覆盖，无法确认 imageAllocation 依赖的分配数值是否保持不变。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/weights.ts#entryWeight 的修改者补充或确认 weightDetails 的实现，确保其返回的 bytes 与原先 Math.ceil(bytes*(1+overhead))+headers 再乘 byteUnit 的结果一致，并保留 bytes<0 时的 RangeError。
